     8	/-!
     9	# The chart twist collapses to ONE θ-family — and GAP-1's mul/tensor does not gate CHART-U(b)
    10	
    11	This file retracts a standing claim of this project, and it is worth stating the claim
    12	first because four roadmap/worksheet records rest on it:
    13	
    14	> `informal/w4-datc-worksheet.md` §0.3 GAP-1 (Σ-INV) and `informal/w4-datb-worksheet.md`
    15	> §1.6 both assert that the chart twist `λ·θᵐ·(−Σ)` "has no route" at the datum layer,
    16	> because there is no `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.mul` or tensor anywhere in the tree; and
    17	> `Picard/Pic0ChartLocusIsOpen.lean`'s header table lists "GAP-1 mul — a datum for a
    18	> *product*, on a common cover refinement" as the ONE unlanded link of the openness route.
    19	
    20	**Both halves of that are wrong, for two independent reasons, and this file proves it.**
    21	
    22	## Reason 1: the twist is not a product of three families, it is one family
    23	
    24	`sigmaFamily C Z T` is *by definition* `thetaFamily C (picClass k Z) T`
    25	(`Picard/DivSchemeAbel.lean:326`, and `degAt_sigmaFamily` proves it by `change`), and
    26	`thetaFamily C L₀ T` is `picEtMap C (toBaseTest T) ((picEtAffineEquiv C k).symm
    27	(PicEtAff.unit C k (relPicMk C (overSpec k k) L₀)))` — a composite of **four group
    28	homomorphisms** applied to `L₀`.  `Scheme.CechPic` is a `CommGroup` (`Picard/Pic.lean:117`).
    29	So `thetaFamily` is multiplicative *in its class argument*:
    30	
    31	* `thetaFamily_mul`, `thetaFamily_inv`, `thetaFamily_pow` — each proved by `map_mul` /
    32	  `map_inv` / `map_pow` four times, nothing else.
    33	
    34	Consequently `chartTwist C m Z T λ = λ · thetaFamily C (θ^m · (picClass k Z)⁻¹) T`
    35	(`chartTwist_collapse`): the Σ-factor and the θᵐ-factor are *the same construction at two
    36	classes*, and they fuse into one call at the single class `θ^m · (picClass k Z)⁻¹`, computed
    37	entirely in `CechPic` over the FIXED base `overSpec k k`.  No datum-level product is
    38	involved anywhere, because the multiplication happens in the Čech Picard *group* before any
    39	datum is extracted.
    40	
    41	## Reason 2: even for a genuine product, presentation is surjective, not constructive
    42	
    43	`BasicOpenCocycleDatum.exists_cechPicClass_eq` (`Cohomology/GluedSheafExtraction.lean:301`)
    44	says: for **every** `c : (relCurve C B).CechPic` there is a datum `D` with
    45	`D.cechPicClass = c`.  It is a surjectivity statement over an arbitrary affine base.  So a
    46	datum presenting a product `c · c'⁻¹` exists *outright* — one applies extraction to the
    47	product class, rather than multiplying two data.  `exists_datum_cechPicClass_mul_inv` below
    48	records this in exactly the shape the openness route wanted.
    49	
    50	A `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.mul` on a common cover refinement would be a *stronger, structured*
    51	statement — it would say the product datum can be built from the two factor data with a
    52	computable cover.  That is a legitimate thing to want, and it is still absent.  It is simply
    53	not what CHART-U(b) needs: the route needs *a* datum with the right class, and extraction
    54	supplies one.
    55	
    56	## What this does and does not resolve
    57	
    58	Resolved: the openness route of `w4-datb` §1.6 (b-amendment) no longer has an unlanded
    59	construction in it.  Its remaining input is the *identification* of the presenting datum's
    60	fibre predicate with the split predicate at each point — `IsChartDatumPresentation`
    61	(`Pic0ChartLocusIsOpen.lean`), which is a statement about `cechPicClass` naturality under
    62	base change to residue fields, not about building a datum.
    63	
    64	NOT resolved, and stated plainly so this file is not over-read: `cechPicClass_inv` (the
    65	class law of `invDatum`) is still unproved, and `invDatum` is now revealed as unnecessary
    66	for the twist — its value, if any, is elsewhere.  Nothing here proves
    67	`IsChartDatumPresentation` for any particular class.
    68	
    69	## Main declarations
    70	
    71	* `AlgebraicGeometry.thetaFamily_mul` / `thetaFamily_inv` / `thetaFamily_pow` — the θ-family
    72	  is a group homomorphism in its class argument.
    73	* `AlgebraicGeometry.sigmaFamily_eq_thetaFamily` — the Σ-family IS a θ-family, recorded.
    74	* **`AlgebraicGeometry.chartTwist_collapse`** — the chart twist is one θ-family.
    75	* `AlgebraicGeometry.exists_datum_cechPicClass_chartTwistClass` — a presenting datum for the
    76	  collapsed twist class exists, with no GAP-1 mul.
    77	* `AlgebraicGeometry.exists_datum_cechPicClass_mul_inv` — the general form: extraction
    78	  already presents any product/inverse.
    79	-/
